capacity_snapshots.semantics: Previously sealed one-second diagnostic snapshots; the stored budget may be the last observation rather than a synchronous capacity census. Zero slots do not independently identify a row shortage; no causal loss fraction or counterfactual DMA success is inferred.

worker_interval_neighbors.launch_timestamp_semantics: scheduler.run_batch entry before telemetry and worker dispatch, not CUDA submission or kernel start. Only explicitly recorded raw timestamps are used; legacy service starts are not substituted.
worker_interval_neighbors.semantics: Consecutive observed worker intervals in processed-completion order. The exported service start is clipped to the previous processed completion, so it is not a raw batch launch. A zero neighboring boundary gap follows from that clipping; it does not prove zero result-processing cost. These fields cannot split kernel, scheduling or overlap time. Cohorts match current native work/context geometry and the following observed phase/batch size, not identical work. Missing geometry or timestamps remain unknown; unobserved native batches may exist.

background_writer_timing.semantics: Measured processing samples completed between writer snapshots. Producer timestamps, queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Samples may span a boundary; cumulative maxima are not window maxima. No multiplication by the sampling interval, full-window cost, GIL attribution, GPU stall or JCT saving is inferred.

predictive_h2d.cuda_graph_semantics: Engine completion result can_run_cuda_graph, paired with this batch. Absent legacy flags remain unknown; batch size alone does not prove replay. Worker intervals include scheduler/result processing and are not kernel timings.

prefill_geometry.semantics: Completed worker intervals, not CUDA kernel timings. Cohorts require native prepared prefix/extend lengths for every batch row; they match batch size, 512-token total-work bins and 2048-token mean-prefix bins. Legacy missing fields or zero defaults do not establish zero prefill work. Partial attributed batches retain unknown total work.

host_match_path_geometry.semantics: Host-hit identity paths recorded at first service, selected by their observation timestamps, not earlier request submission timestamps. Identical recorded paths expose repeat observation; no FULL/Mamba reuse, CPU time or native-relative latency saving is inferred.

periodic_decode_graph_log.flag_source: GenerationBatchResult.can_run_cuda_graph -> process_batch_result_decode -> metrics_reporter.report_decode_stats for that completed batch.
periodic_decode_graph_log.semantics: Periodic decode log samples, not all batches or kernel timings. Second-resolution timestamps represent a one-second bucket; samples straddling the requested half-open window are excluded. No flag is backfilled into runtime_audit batches or extrapolated to unsampled batches. Missing logs and observed zero samples differ.

semantics: Complete cross-version development window, not identical demand or final JCT acceptance. Reuse the fixed native summary without scanning its raw logs. Python exclusive wall totals are not removable JCT or GPU kernels. Busy-window and sealed-capacity inputs have independent cutoffs.
